_about: Golden values for PT Pertamina Hulu Energi dan entitas anaknya, FY2024, in thousands of USD, copied from docs/spec/01_PRD.md §A6. The PRD's author read them from the audited consolidated statements (EY report 00489/2.1032/AU.1/02/1726-4/1/III/2025). scripts/fs_check.py compares each with the printed value of the row carrying that line_key; [0] is 31 December 2024 or the year 2024, [1] is 2023. Everything else is read from the PDF, not from this file.
